title.narrative: Conservation International GEF Small Grants Programme 2.0 (CI SGP 2.0)

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

Project Objective: To support and foster the active leadership of community-based organizations and other CSOs including those led by women, youth, Indigenous Peoples (where present) and Local Communities in delivering solutions to local environmental problems in ways that contribute to the achievement of national and Global Environmental Benefits and national poverty reduction

The SGP 2.0, implemented by Conservation International through the CEPF mechanism, is designed to deliver both global environmental benefits and tangible improvements in local livelihoods by empowering civil society actors—particularly women, youth, Indigenous Peoples, and Local Communities—to lead community-based solutions. By providing targeted grants and tailored support, the project will enable these groups to address environmental degradation, biodiversity loss, and climate change impacts while promoting sustainable development. This will also strengthen resilience among beneficiary communities and generate income opportunities. Through capacity building, advocacy, and knowledge-sharing, the project will enhance the institutional and technical capabilities of CSOs, lower barriers to participation, and foster inclusive leadership. Ultimately, SGP 2.0 will contribute to poverty reduction and socio-ecological resilience by ensuring that marginalized and underrepresented groups are not only beneficiaries but active agents of change in shaping sustainable futures.
